lead: Personal and collected papers and cards (letters, autographs, manuscripts, photographs, postcards, ephemera, share certificates, payment, transit and phone cards, identity and legal papers), organised by what the document is, with makers, issuers, eras and processes as the collector axes.

depts.note: Collector end of personal papers; bound manuscript books and codices are in Media & Publications.

b.w: Weighed first; a fact of one sheet, shown through named forms and the autograph-dealer scale.

b.v: third-party letter of authenticity (PSA/DNA, JSA, Beckett) or provenance > dealer guarantee > none
b.w: Autograph market practice; forgeries and secretarial/autopen signatures are the main risk.

b.v: ALS > LS > TLS > DS > AL > AQS > AMQS > cut signature
b.w: Wholly handwritten ranks above secretarial and typed (autograph-dealer abbreviations).
Second after the writer.
Historically significant content raises value.
Weighed last.

s.brief: Coverage plus authentication. Autograph: forms as t types (cut signature, signed index card, signed photograph, album page, signed shikishi board, inscribed book is F1); add the abbreviation ladder in the definition notes. Put authentication services (PSA/DNA, JSA James Spence Authentication, Beckett Authentication Services, and any other major one you can source) into the brand register with seg 'Autograph authentication', and mention autopen/secretarial signatures as an attribute. Letter: types (autograph letter signed, typed letter signed, love letter, wartime/field-post letter, V-mail/airgraph, aerogramme). Posted envelope: keep restrained (postal history proper is in Coins, Stamps); types censored cover, crash cover, airmail. Written-in greeting card: types valentine, Christmas card, birthday card; Victorian valentines and early Christmas cards (e.g. Henry Cole 1843) as archetypes if sourced. NEW Autograph album: Victorian autograph/friendship album, school leavers' book, Japanese yosegaki/shikishi collections; source it.

k.brief: New: album kept to collect signatures and messages.

s.brief: Manuscripts finding. NEW Manuscript document: single handwritten historical documents (vellum charter, indenture, land grant, manorial roll, ship's papers, papal bull, firman) as t types or archetypes where a named form exists (indenture, charter, bull, firman); materials vellum/parchment/paper as detail. Diary or journal: types (travel journal, ship's log, war diary, five-year diary). Written-in notebook: types commonplace book, manuscript recipe book, school exercise book, account book. Bound codices, illuminated manuscripts and incunabula stay in Media & Publications; cross-link only.

k.brief: New: single handwritten historical document such as a charter, indenture or land grant.

depts.note: Vernacular and family photographs by process, postcards by era and publisher; fine-art photography is in Art.

b.v: Pioneer (to 1898) > Private Mailing Card (1898-1901) > Undivided back (1901-07) > Divided back (1907-15) > White border > Linen > Chrome
b.w: Standard US/UK postcard-era scheme used by dealers; golden age 1895 to the First World War weighed first.
Collectors sort by publisher (Tuck, Detroit, Teich, Valentine) and signed artist.

b.v: daguerreotype > ambrotype > tintype > albumen CDV/cabinet card > gelatin silver snapshot
b.w: Process dates and values a vernacular photograph.
Topographic views, occupational, post-mortem, named sitters as tags, not kinds.
Folds, foxing, fading, scratches.
The only quality signal named for albums.

s.brief: Publishers and eras finding. Picture postcard: archetypes by publisher line, ordered by significance, e.g. Raphael Tuck & Sons (Oilette), Detroit Publishing Co. Photochrom, Curt Teich linen, Valentine & Sons, J. Salmon, Bamforth comic cards, Wiener Werkstätte cards, Photochrom Zürich; eras as t or detail (Pioneer, Private Mailing Card, Undivided back, Divided back, White border, Linen, Chrome); types artist-signed, topographic, greetings, propaganda. Put publishers in the brand register (seg 'Postcard publisher'). NEW Real photo postcard (RPPC; was a model under Photograph): photo-paper stock backs (AZO, Velox, Cyko, Kodak) as detail if sourced. NEW Novelty postcard: hold-to-light, silk/embroidered (WWI silks), woven Stevengraph, leather, mechanical, aluminium, oversize — as t types. NEW Postcard album (collection albums travel with what they hold).

k.brief: New: photograph printed on postcard-backed photo paper.
New: postcard made of or with unusual materials or mechanisms.
New: album made to hold postcards.

s.brief: Organise vernacular photographs by process/format, ordered historically. Rename 'Other photographs' to Photographic print (generic loose print; RPPC moves to Postcards). Keep Carte de visite, Cabinet card, Snapshot. NEW kinds: Daguerreotype (cased, 1839-c.1860), Ambrotype, Tintype (ferrotype), Stereoview card (stereograph; publishers Keystone View Company, Underwood & Underwood, London Stereoscopic Company as archetypes if sourced), Instant print (Polaroid peel-apart, SX-70, Instax as archetypes). Slide: types glass lantern slide, 35 mm Kodachrome slide, View-Master reel (if it stays here; else note). Negative: types glass plate, sheet film, roll/strip. Case sizes (sixth plate, quarter plate) and photographer studios as detail only.

Restraint. Photo album: keep a few market brands, types (slip-in, self-adhesive, traditional mounting, Victorian CDV album); archival quality as the criterion. Film album: storage binders for negatives/slides, keep the University Products models. Scrapbook, home film reel (types 8 mm, Super 8, 9.5 mm, 16 mm), home videotape (types VHS, VHS-C, Video8/Hi8, MiniDV, Betamax) kept plain.

depts.note: Everyday printed paper kept after use; posters are in Art, booklets and catalogues in Media & Publications.

b.w: First for paper ephemera generally (Ephemera Society practice).
Second.
Third.
Fourth.

s.brief: Coverage. Ticket stub: types concert, sports, rail (Edmondson card ticket as archetype if sourced), airline ticket/boarding pass, cinema, ocean-liner; full unused tickets vs stubs as detail. Programme: types concert tour programme, theatre playbill, sports matchday programme, opera. Timetable: railway public timetables, airline timetables, Bradshaw's Guide as archetype if sourced. Lottery ticket: types draw ticket, scratch card. NEW Luggage label: hotel, shipping-line and airline baggage labels, a recognised collecting field.

k.brief: New: printed hotel, shipping or airline label stuck on luggage.

s.brief: Menu: types ocean-liner menu, railway dining-car menu, banquet menu, restaurant menu; named lines (White Star, Cunard) only as detail or archetypes if sourced. Invitation: types wedding, royal/state, dance card (or a NEW Dance card kind is not needed; keep as type). Visiting card: types engraved, die-cut, hidden-name/escort card; card cases are in Bags & Accessories. Business card kept plain.

Advertising trade card: Victorian chromolithographed stock and custom cards as types; issuers as detail; series cards are in Coins, Stamps, Medals & Trading Cards. Handbill: types flyer, leaflet, magazine advertisement page. Broadside: types proclamation, auction notice, wanted notice, playbill (one-sheet). Receipt: types billhead, letterhead invoice, stamped receipt.

Bookplate (ex libris): print-technique types (woodcut, wood engraving, etching, offset) and FISAE/ex-libris collecting; notable designer archetypes only if sourced. Bookmark: Stevengraph woven silk bookmarks as archetype (Thomas Stevens, Coventry) with the existing models as versions; types celluloid, advertising. Label: types fruit-crate label, cigar-box label, wine label, luggage labels are separate. NEW Matchbox label (phillumeny; collecting body British Matchbox Label & Booklet Society). NEW Victorian scrap (die-cut embossed chromolithographed scraps; makers e.g. Mamelok, Raphael Tuck) if sourced.

k.brief: New: die-cut printed paper relief collected in albums.

depts.note: Scripophily at the collector end; banknotes and scrip are in Coins, Stamps, Medals & Trading Cards.

b.w: Scripophily values famous companies, defaulted governments and early dates first.
Certificates signed by famous figures (Rockefeller, Edison) carry large premiums.

b.v: engraved vignette by a security printer > lithographed
b.w: American Bank Note Co., Bradbury Wilkinson and similar printers.
Collector convention.

b.v: Excellent > Very good > Good > Fair > Needs restoration
b.w: Dealer scale.

s.brief: Scripophily finding. Share certificate and Bond certificate: archetypes for famous/collected issues if sourced (e.g. Standard Oil signed by Rockefeller, early railroad stocks, Russian imperial and railway bonds, Chinese government bonds such as the 1913 Reorganisation Loan, Confederate bonds, VOC and Mississippi/South Sea period shares, Disney 'Mickey' share); security printers (American Bank Note Company, Bradbury Wilkinson, Waterlow & Sons) in the brand register; types bearer/registered, specimen. Mention the International Bond & Share Society (IBSS) in the dept criteria source if fetched. Cheque: types bank cheque, signed cheque (celebrity), specimen. Traveller's cheque (American Express, Thomas Cook), Postal order (types British postal order, US money order), Promissory note kept plain.

depts.note: Held cards; collectors follow issuers and series (Colnect catalogue axes).

b.w: Collectors catalogue cards by issuer, then series and issue date (Colnect).
Defines phone-card and transit-card generations.
Collector convention for phone and transit cards.

b.v: print run, limited or commemorative edition
b.w: Weighed after issuer.

s.brief: Transit cards to an issuer register with icons only: cut the 230-card model list to about 12-15 icon archetypes ordered by significance (Octopus 1997 as the pioneer contactless card, Oyster, Suica, EZ-Link, T-money, Clipper, SmarTrip, MetroCard as magnetic predecessor, Opal, Navigo, OV-chipkaart, Presto, Leap Card, myki), with commemorative/limited editions as versions if sourced; move every other card/issuer pair into the brand register as stubs (seg 'Transit card issuer', name, country, card name in lines), not into the tree. Remove the stray National Common Mobility Card range from the payment kinds (it is a transit/payment card; keep it as a stub). Telephone card: technology types (optical Landis & Gyr, magnetic GPT/Autelca, chip/SmartCard), archetypes for the Japanese NTT telephone card (terekā), French Télécarte, BT Phonecard if sourced; Colnect as reference. SIM card: types full-size, mini, micro, nano; collector note only.

Tier for current cards, collector icons for history. Archetypes only for sourced firsts: Charga-Plate (charge plate), Diners Club card (1950), American Express card (1958, paper then plastic), BankAmericard (1958, later Visa), Access/Barclaycard in the UK if sourced. Merge ATM card into Debit card as a type. Credit card types: standard, premium/metal, co-branded, store card. Prepaid e-money card: reduce the six models to a few sourced icons (Edy, nanaco, Flazz) or types; drop the NCMC range here.

Restraint. Gift card and gift certificate kept separate (plastic vs paper voucher). Membership card plain; Loyalty card keep the one model or move it to a type. Key card types hotel key card, access fob card.

depts.note: Held as one's own papers; old passports are collected but have no quality ladder.

b.w: For current documents only validity matters; PRADO describes security features.

b.m: Collectors: age, issuing state and stamps
b.w: Old passports and IDs are valued for period, rare issuers and visa stamps.

s.brief: Restraint. Merge Crew member certificate into Work identity card (rename Identity badge) as a type alongside employee ID badge. Access badge: types event pass, backstage laminate, press pass. Passport types (ordinary, diplomatic, Nansen passport, historical passport). Keep national ID aliases as types or aliases.

depts.note: Personal records; decorative certificates made as pictures (Fraktur, ketubah art) are in Art.

b.v: Excellent > Very good > Good > Fair > Needs restoration
b.w: First for old documents; a dealer's own scale.
Second.

s.brief: Civil docs to 2 kinds: Civil registration certificate (types birth, marriage, civil partnership, death, divorce decree; aliases birth certificate etc.) and Religious rite certificate (types baptism/christening incl. Taufschein, confirmation, first communion, bar/bat mitzvah, ketubah as marriage contract). Vaccination certificate kept (types yellow card / International Certificate of Vaccination). Diploma, certificate of achievement (reward of merit card as type), school report kept plain.
Restraint. Deed: Indenture becomes a type (older handwritten indentures can also sit under Manuscript document). Will, Tax paper, House plans kept plain.
